changes_made.explanation: Consolidated redundant guideline descriptions into one clear statement. Normalized criteria to title case and removed duplicates. The human evaluation was explicitly described with 5 criteria scored on a 1-3 scale.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on Sequential Question Generation (SQG) as its main NLG task. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some redundancy and inconsistent formatting. The paper uses both automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR) and human evaluation with clearly defined criteria. No LLM evaluation methods were used (paper predates common LLM-as-judge practices).
